div.div: The shopper's own, or an example.
Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings puts it in the same vector space as the garments' text.
Embedding similarity on the graph's garments finds the starting garments.
The looks that contain them, and the other garments worn there.
The model writes the answer from those looks. Each suggestion names its look.

div.span: The looks and what they wear

div.div: The same flow answers it. Only the input changes.
